title: Tipot/One Tiny Seed
program_note:
This composition began life as Tipot, a solo piano work in which a slow cascade of notes, in always-descending lines, coalesces into snippets of known melodies (“Tipot” is Hebrew for “drops”; this piece is dedicated to the victims of terrorism in Israel).  Shortly after its completion I came to know Rachel Golberg-Polin’s devastating poem One Tiny Seed, which is also a response to the terrorist attack of October 7, 2023—in which her son Hersh had his arm blown off by a grenade—but is really a humanist prayer for peace and reconciliation.  I realized that the original piano music matched the pace of the poem, and that the text could be lain on top of the music, enhancing its meaning.

The music is about 4’45” in duration.

David S. Lef kowitz
Los Angeles, CA
30 January, 2024
